items.t: GM Is Looking Outside the Company for Its Next CEO
items.sum: Mary Barra's stock record looks strong on the surface, yet GM's board has quietly called in a search firm. The question is who might replace her, and whether the next chief will keep the EV spending and buybacks intact.
